method: measure_power_android.py, 10-minute windows, 60-second samples, BatteryManager charge counter (uAh)
controlled: screen on at 200/255 brightness, auto-brightness off, app force-stopped, keep-awake ping every 60 s to stop Wi-Fi from sleeping
finding: the two windows with identical settings (auto-sync off) differ by 2.4x (95.7 vs 227.4 mAh/h), so this method cannot separate the auto-sync toggle from run-to-run noise
why_the_toggle_cannot_show_up: the scheduled job runs at most once an hour, so a 10-minute window usually contains no run at all
with no paired device the run exits immediately after building an empty record set
the only run observed in this session was the foreground attempt at 23:20 (logcat: 'auto_sync skipped: no paired device')
limits: no power meter or thermal chamber; numbers come from the battery's own charge counter
screen brightness fixed but display content not pinned, so compositor load varies between windows
the earlier 2026-10-31 figures (240 mAh/h idle, 588 mAh/h under continuous model load) have the same uncertainty and cannot be compared across days
measuring the cost of a real peer-to-peer sync still needs a second device
